item.title: Finland pledges over $2M in humanitarian aid to Haiti, PM Fils-Aimé says
item.description: Finland’s pledge comes at a critical time, with more than 1.4 million Haitians displaced by gang violence and 5.7 million facing food insecurity. The Haitian government expects to spend the funding on humanitarian programs for the most vulnerable. item.title: Port-de-Paix residents welcome first fire truck in decades, hope service returns for good
item.description: Port-de-Paix has received its first fire truck in decades. The truck and an ambulance are part of a $3 million package from CPSOTA, a diaspora-linked nonprofit organization based in Montreal, to help rehabilitate and strengthen emergency services across Haiti.
